$comment: Disposition-classed allowlist for scripts/secret-scan.mjs (mirrors npm-audit-allowlist.json). Classes: 'rotated-historical' = the secret is in unrewritable git history but PROVEN dead — permanent, requires rotationEvidence; 'false-positive' = not a secret — requires a dated expiry so the ruling gets re-examined. The wrapper REJECTS any entry outside this schema.

entries.justification: Ed25519 private key committed with the local Neon compose experiment (2026-07-02); its public half was the live compute_ctl trust anchor until rotation. History is never rewritten, so the finding is permanent.
entries.rotationEvidence: Rotated on the live OKE cluster 2026-08-15 (verified: compute-jwt-trust Secret created via gen-secrets.sh, rotated ConfigMap applied, 0 occurrences of the leaked key in the live ConfigMap, wake drill 0->1->0->1 passed twice). Tracked in PR #730 (open, all four gates passed: code+spec APPROVE, architect+system-designer SIGN-OFF), which lands the repo-side rotation and the tests/compute-jwt-trust-guard.test.ts guard banning all four encodings. Merge order: #730 before or with this gate.
